# Authored fixtures

Unlike `../p1` and `../p2` (recorded from the generation-1 server by `scripts/record_protocol_fixtures.py`),
these files were written by hand in T123, from the generation-1 code that builds them
(`serverdata/usage.py`, `server/api.py`) or, for the remote-tool route, from the T123 design (the route is new
in generation 2 and has no generation-1 recording). They are not evidence of generation-1 bytes.
